notes: FIXED: the Android update loop. The Android app kept saying an update was available, sent you to Chrome to download the APK, and then nothing changed — because the downloadable APK is still the 0.67.1 build (new APKs can only be built on the PC), while the update feed advertised the newer web version. The feed now keeps the two apart: the Android app is only offered a download when a genuinely newer APK exists, and the next Android build loads the live app itself, so from then on it updates the moment the web does (with the bundled copy kept for offline). Want the newest version on Android today? Open mreindl118-boop.github.io/GuitarPak in Chrome and choose Install app — it updates itself and MIDI keyboards work there.
